summary: Tokyo Lifestyle Co., Ltd. furnished a Form 6-K on November 6, 2026, transmitting the notice of convocation and proxy card for an extraordinary general meeting of shareholders to be held in Tokyo on November 30, 2026. Shareholders will vote on the appropriation of surplus, including a previously disclosed cash dividend of JPY1.432 per ordinary share, and on a proposed stated-capital reduction of JPY284,419,000, from JPY294,419,000 to JPY10,000,000, with the entire reduction transferred to capital reserve. The capital reduction, approved by the board on October 22, 2026, requires shareholder approval plus Japanese creditor-protection procedures and is expected effective December 11, 2026. This is a routine meeting notice, not a special situation; watch for quorum and proxy-vote outcomes.
